notes: All native timestamps use same receipt clockOriginUptime, absolute decoder clocks were converted to it.
onset_to_ready includes VAD, worker creation, model load and IPC scheduling; its substeps are not individually instrumented.
The timestamps of the ready and model events are callback receipt times in the host, not an instrumented worker-spawn boundary.
The visible frame observer polls every 35 ms. Window timings have that measurement granularity.
All 15 first hypotheses and prior PCM decode frame boundaries are identical in the three cohorts.
All 15 new first hypotheses arrived before any verified-prefix preview path; all trace counts are zero through first text.
Comparisons of median values do not add, paired arithmetic means of phase deltas do add.
No ASR rerun or source change was made for this analysis.

conclusion.confirmed: All ten cases with later first visible text already had a later host-observed ready event. The new verified-prefix path did not execute before first text in any of the 15 cases, as established by the worker condition, zero verified counts and identical initial PCM boundaries.
conclusion.attribution: The added median delay is consistent with pre-ready startup / host scheduling differences. The ready event does not separately identify VAD, process spawn, model IO, compilation, or GPU preparation, so none of those is proven as the unique cause.
conclusion.first_decode: The first decoder invocation itself is faster in the candidate median, at 200 ms versus 255 ms. Some individual invocations are slower. The empty draft-state bookkeeping added to the ordinary greedy path is not isolated by these receipts.
conclusion.scope: This is postprocessing existing raw native receipts. No app or model was run, no new load was generated, and the archive CER comparison and prior scoring remained unchanged.
conclusion.ordinary_greedy_condition: Worker.swift gates verifyingPreview on !last.isEmpty and samples.count >= 48000. Before the first text last is empty; all first text boundaries in this set are at most 44800.
